case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quick and clear offer for the SH-220 shaft. We appreciate your practical approach and would be glad to work with you.

To be transparent, we have another offer on the table:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

To award the part to you, we would need to come closer to that level. Here is what we can propose:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option C keeps your payment terms exactly as you offered them, so nothing changes on your side except the price. Please let us know which option works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Hallo, thanks for being straight with us about the other offer. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

For now, our Angebot stands at a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your openness and for checking the competing quote so carefully. We appreciate that you took it into account, and we know you still need to clarify the price internally.

To make that internal discussion easier, we have prepared three options for you to put to your team:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.20; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.10; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option C keeps your usual payment terms. The other two trade a longer payment period for a lower price, so you can choose the balance that suits your business best. Any of them would let us move ahead with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Gruß

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal and are very keen to win your business and demonstrate our capabilities as a reliable, long-term partner. For this position, our offer includes a price of €16.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

We look forward to the opportunity of working together and building a successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

messages.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your prompt and detailed proposal for the SH-220 stainless shaft. We appreciate your interest in a long-term partnership.

We are evaluating this award carefully. To move forward, we would need terms closer to the options below. Each one includes delivery to our site.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

Any of these options would put your proposal in a strong position. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully evaluated your options and are committed to finding a mutually beneficial agreement. 

Our offer is a price of €16.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. We can accommodate the reduced 35-day lead time, but DAP delivery adds significant logistics costs that limit our flexibility. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Any further step needs approval from our management. 

Alternatively, we can present another package with delivery EXW: a price of €16.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
